title: •Count Me In
caption: •Count Me In (V)
game_text: Use 2 Force to deploy on Leia (even if a captive) or Back Door. Attrition against opponent is +1. Once per game, may place this Effect out of play to cancel a Force drain at same or related site.
lore: Leia couldn’t let Han out of her sight.
